text:
Hi, I’m Mina Castellan. I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, with strong SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets skills.

On a Marketing attribution analysis project for Verdant Skincare, I built a model in BigQuery to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit across ad channels; it helped reallocate 18% of ad budget and reduce CAC by 12% the next quarter. On a Subscription churn cohorts project, I built monthly retention curves and an onboarding funnel; we found one onboarding step linked to 40% of first-month churn.

For your HubSpot pipeline, I can help with setup logistics, import cleanup, and limited data entry, while structuring it so relationships between multiple customers and prospects are trackable. How are you currently representing those relationships in HubSpot—associations, companies, or custom properties?
